stories.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
stories.simple_summary: A startup built an AI tool that tries to understand what plants are communicating through the electricity flowing in their stems. Right now this is an early science experiment.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to scientists and investors. There's nothing a regular person or small business owner needs to do about it.

stories.title: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
stories.simple_summary: Spotify removed over 50 million songs that were either made entirely by AI or were spam from its recommendation system. The service is now trying to show you more real music made by actual musicians instead.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Spotify, you might find better music recommendations now since the app has cleaned up a lot of junk.

stories.title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
stories.simple_summary: The company Figma is deciding how to connect its design tool to AI systems in a careful way. This is mostly a technical decision about behind-the-scenes standards.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and investors. It doesn't affect regular people or small business owners.

stories.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
stories.simple_summary: The US government told all its offices to remove and stop using a Chinese AI tool called DeepSeek because of security worries. The government is treating it as a risk to national safety.
stories.why_it_matters: Most small business owners won't be affected unless they work for the federal government or use DeepSeek software in their company.

stories.title: Adobe Lightroom mobile can now open closed eyes in photos with a simple tap
stories.simple_summary: Adobe's photo editing app called Lightroom can now fix photos where someone has their eyes closed by using AI to open them with a single tap. It works on phones and tablets.
stories.why_it_matters: If you take lots of photos on your phone and use Lightroom, this could save you time fixing pictures where people blinked during the shot.

stories.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
stories.simple_summary: A company called Eka made a robot arm that is very good at picking up different kinds of objects smoothly and naturally. Investors think it's worth 1.45 billion dollars.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large factories. Most small businesses won't have use for it yet.

stories.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
stories.simple_summary: A meeting note-taking tool called Otter.ai just raised 320 million dollars in funding to expand its business. The company wants to grow and reach more customers worldwide.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
stories.simple_summary: Yelp is adding AI features to its app that can call restaurants for you to check wait times and give you personalized suggestions based on what you like. It remembers your food preferences.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Yelp to find restaurants, this could save you a phone call and help you discover new places you'd actually enjoy.

stories.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
stories.simple_summary: A New York City official is saying the government hasn't done enough to control AI and is urging New Yorkers to demand stronger rules that protect people's rights. He's arguing against the idea that AI takeover is unavoidable.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in New York, this is about local government pushing for rules that might affect how companies use AI in your city.

stories.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
stories.simple_summary: A company may be doing another very large expensive deal with an AI lab to buy computing power. These kinds of deals are becoming common in the AI industry.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
stories.simple_summary: A policy leader at a major AI organization says that putting neutral observers inside AI companies to check safety isn't a simple solution. It's more complicated than people think.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government regulators and tech company leaders thinking about AI safety. Most people don't need to worry about this.

stories.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft is warning companies that AI agents and tools can be risky and unpredictable if they're not carefully watched. It's like having a new employee you don't fully trust yet.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses AI tools from other companies, this is a reminder to be careful about what information you give them and to keep an eye on how they work.
